dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: Yes... Yes! This place is good. It's a good spot for takeoff!

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: From a suitable location, of course? Oh, hello, Traveler. Nice to meet you. I'm Hughes, an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: Well, I say that... But I've honestly spent more time researching ways to use my wind glider than I have at the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ways to use your wind glider?

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: Indeed. It's a real science, it is.

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: Some who put on a wind glider can soar with the birds, but others... well, they don't get very far.

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: Ultimately, it has to do with individual differences in one's grasp on various gliding techniques.

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: The best way to refine one's technique, to whit, is via practical drills.

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: Traveler, you have a wind glider too, right? I've just discovered a most excellent spot from which one can utilize wind gliders...

dialogues.speaker: Hughes
dialogues.text: So how about it? How would you like to spread your wings and soar?

response.speaker: Hughes
response.text: Great! Just let me mark it on your map...

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Hughes
response.text: Sure, go finish what you have to first.
